params.name: customers[]
params.description: List of customer IDs to filter, e.g.: customers[]=1&customers[]=2

params.name: start
params.description: Only projects that started before this date will be included. Allowed format: HTML5 (default: now, if end is also empty)

params.name: end
params.description: Only projects that ended after this date will be included. Allowed format: HTML5 (default: now, if start is also empty)

params.name: ignoreDates
params.description: If set, start and end are completely ignored. Allowed values: 1 (default: off)

params.name: globalActivities
params.description: If given, filters projects by their 'global activity' support. Allowed values: 1 (supports global activities) and 0 (without global activities) (default: all)

params.name: order
params.description: The result order. Allowed values: ASC, DESC (default: ASC)

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The field by which results will be ordered. Allowed values: id, name, customer (default: name)
